name: chrome
description: Browser Use for CardBush integrated tabs and paired Chrome or Edge on Windows 11, with explicit per-conversation targets.

interface.shortDescription: Control CardBush, Chrome and Edge pages
interface.longDescription: Use @ to control the exact CardBush integrated tab without pairing, or separately pair Chrome and Edge profiles on Windows 11. Each conversation retains its selected browser. Closed or unavailable tabs never redirect control to another browser with the same URL. External personal tabs require extension authorization. Advanced remote debugging remains a separate Chrome-only mode.
defaultPrompt: Open a web page and inspect its contents
Use Edge or Chrome to interact with an authorized page

zh.shortDescription: 操作 CardBush 内置标签及授权的 Chrome、Edge 页面
zh.longDescription: 通过 @ 操作准确的 CardBush 内置标签，无需扩展配对；也可分别配对 Windows 11 上的 Chrome、Edge 及其用户配置。每个会话保持明确的浏览器目标，标签关闭或不可用时不会转到其他浏览器的同网址页面。外部个人标签仍需在扩展中授权。高级远程调试是独立的 Chrome 专用模式。
defaultPrompt: 打开网页并检查页面内容
使用 Edge 或 Chrome 操作授权网页
